description: This Java class 'DefaultHttpPushFactory' implements the 'HttpPushFactory' interface, providing methods to create HTTP requests and connection flows using Akka HTTP, with support for SSL contexts, proxy configurations, and connection pooling. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.httppush' package and manages HTTP push connections with customizable settings.

classes.name: DefaultHttpPushFactory
classes.description: Final class implementing HttpPushFactory, responsible for creating HTTP requests and connection flows with support for SSL, proxies, and connection pooling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultHttpPushFactory based on a Connection, HttpPushConfig, and ConnectionLogger, configuring SSL context if the scheme is secure.

methods.name: newRequest
methods.description: Creates a new HttpRequest with method and URI based on the target, including basic auth credentials if user info is present.

methods.name: createFlow
methods.description: Creates an Akka HTTP connection pool flow for requests and responses, supporting HTTPS if configured.

methods.name: getConnectionPoolSettings
methods.description: Generates connection pool settings with max connections and optional transport based on client transport.

methods.name: disambiguateByConnectionId
methods.description: Creates unique connection pool settings for a given connection ID, ensuring proper caching and settings per connection.

methods.name: parseParallelism
methods.description: Parses the 'parallelism' setting from a configuration map, defaulting to 1.
